predictions.articleTitle: Young Lions vs Tanjong Pagar Prediction & Match Analysis: Midfield Absences vs Defensive Leaks
predictions.coreRecommendation: Tanjong Pagar are favored to win or claim a high-scoring draw at Jalan Besar against a Young Lions side allowing 3.50 goals per match.
possibilityAssessment: Tanjong Pagar Win or Draw remains the primary direction due to superior attacking output and Young Lions' 21 goals conceded in six league games (Confidence: Moderate, Value: High)
Over 2.5 goals aligns with a 4.16 combined Poisson lambda and nine of both clubs' twelve combined league matches clearing three goals (Confidence: High, Value: High)
Both Teams To Score (Yes) reflects Young Lions' five-game scoring run meeting a Tanjong Pagar backline still chasing its first clean sheet (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Suspension of Gallagher leaves Tanjong Pagar exposed against resurgent Young Lions.

spf.comment: Tanjong Pagar lead the 1:2 away-win script against Young Lions' 3.50 GA/gm defense, while Gallagher's suspension keeps a 2:2 draw live.

over_under.comment: A 4.16 combined lambda (78.4% Over 2.5 probability) and 6.17 combined goals conceded per game strongly favor three or more goals.

btts.comment: Both defenses average 2.67+ goals conceded per game with Tanjong Pagar holding zero clean sheets and Young Lions scoring in five straight.

score.comment: 1:2 holds the top Poisson scoreline density (7.8%) with 2:2 (7.1%) capturing the draw path if Young Lions exploit midfield gaps.

goals.comment: Four goals (19.5%) and three goals (18.7%) represent the two highest-probability Poisson bands around the 4.16 total lambda.

bqc.comment: Draw-Loss captures a cagey post-break opening before Tanjong Pagar pull away late, while Loss-Draw covers a Young Lions second-half comeback.
